  The notifier sends through the email provider's HTTP API (provider.send). Production credentials exist only in the deployed function's environment. For development there is a separate sandbox account whose key is in the dev secrets store; export it as MAIL_API_KEY. The sandbox has the same API and response shapes, but it is rate-limited to 2 messages per second and capped at 500 messages a day for the whole team, so do not loop over large fixtures. Bounces and complaints are simulated with magic addresses from the provider's docs. Important: the sandbox silently drops (answers 202, never delivers) every message whose recipient is not on the `@sink.acme.test` domain, so a test that asserts delivery must send to an address such as `receipts@sink.acme.test` and read it back from the sink inbox API.
- [context] Who owns the notifier (current) (id: 01a10bf3-090f-7c13-bccb-a48f665e94ee; source: shared/human)
  As of 2026-09-01 the notifier belongs to the Growth team (Dana Okafor moved to Platform). Template and copy changes are signed off in #growth-eng; any Growth engineer can approve.","hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit"}}

The Growth team has to sign off. Ask in **#growth-eng**, where any Growth engineer can approve a template or copy change. Dana Okafor used to own the notifier and no longer does, because she moved to Platform on 2026-09-01.

The repo has no CODEOWNERS file or README note on this, so the answer comes from the project's memory records. An older record naming Dana as the approver has already been superseded by the Growth one.

For the change itself:
- The receipt template is an `.mjml` file in `services/notifier/templates/`.
- It has a plain-text twin `.txt` file. Update both with the same wording and the same snake_case variables.
